question: Simplify: [(9x + 4y)² - (9x - 4y)²] div 24x
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

= [(9x+4y) − (9x−4y)] × [(9x+4y) + (9x−4y)]

= (8y)(18x) = 144xy

Divide by 24x ⇒ 144xy / 24x = 6y

**∴ Answer = 6y**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[(9x + 4y)² − (9x − 4y)²] ÷ 24x

**Formula used:**

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let a = (9x + 4y), b = (9x − 4y)

⇒ a − b = 8y

⇒ a + b = 18x

⇒ Expression = (8y)(18x) ÷ 24x

⇒ = 144xy ÷ 24x

⇒ = 6y

**∴ The correct answer is 6y.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Simplification Tip

Cancel common factors before final step.

Quick Trick

Use (a+b)² − (a−b)² = 4ab directly.
